bias.zh: 反弹 · 跌破 $782，守住 200 日均线

read.en: Micron fell 2.5% on Nov 13 to $778.31, trading $750.25–796.18. It is above the 5-day ($769.3, rising), 10-day ($767.7) and 200-day ($765.6, rising), and below the 30-day ($889.6) and 100-day ($943.0), both falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 30, below zero, histogram nearly closed (a cross up is close); Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($874.60), and RSI is 42.5.
read.zh: 美光 11月13日下跌 2.5%，收于 $778.31，盘中区间 $750.25–796.18。股价位于 5 日（$769.3，上行）、10 日（$767.7）和 200 日均线（$765.6，上行）上方，30 日（$889.6）和 100 日均线（$943.0）下方，二者均在下行。MACD 自 10月30日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图接近收拢（临近上穿）；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$874.60），RSI 为 42.5。

read.en: The close slipped under the Nov 4 low ($782), now resistance, but the $750.25 low recovered and the 5, 10 and 200-day held. Resistance is $782–798.4 (Nov 4 low and close, Nov 12 close), then $811.3 and $827.6–833.6. Support is $763–769 (5, 10 and 200-day, Nov 11–12 lows), then $737.9–750.3 and $725 (Nov 10 close). A close above $798.4 would target $811–828; below $763, $738–750.
